user_query: entries in the trass.stories database with term UK

intent.goal: find entries containing 'UK' in trass.stories database
intent._validation_feedback: Results don't match intended databases. Got {'stories'}, expected {'trass.stories'}

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
u.database_name,
g.message_content,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet 
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass' 
AND u.database_name = 'trass.stories'
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%uk%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;

validation.message: Results look good: 3 entries from 1 databases
